first_cohort: UNSELECTED: one existing HCM design-partner tenant, at most 50 pilot users with a named executive sponsor; tenant name and sponsor require commercial approval
served_provider: Anthropic behind the SchemaFlux model gateway
deferred_providers: OpenAI: deferred for the pilot; re-run provider selection on eval evidence before adding a second provider, never add one silently
Approved private model endpoints: deferred for the pilot; same reselection criterion

admitted_jobs.name: Answer HR policy questions in the asker's own chat DM
admitted_jobs.governance: Runs ON_BEHALF_OF with the asker's current authority; reads governed records (T0) and answers only inside the asker's DM (T1); anything it proposes beyond the answer compiles through internal/agentsecurity/action_compiler.go into an attributed draft, and deterministic gateways perform all subsequent governance

admitted_jobs.name: Draft announcements privately for the user's review
admitted_jobs.governance: Draft visible only to the user; posting the draft anywhere needs a separate per-task T2 destination confirmation; drafts compile through internal/agentsecurity/action_compiler.go with exact arguments, sources and model versions

admitted_jobs.name: Report workflow status the asker may already read
admitted_jobs.governance: Read-only over workflows the asker is authorized to read; never starts, advances, approves or decides a workflow; every lookup compiles through internal/agentsecurity/action_compiler.go as a read with stated sources

admitted_jobs.name: Post a user-confirmed update to named channel destinations
admitted_jobs.governance: Per-task confirmation of every destination before posting; destinations fixed at confirmation time; content compiles through internal/agentsecurity/action_compiler.go with exact arguments and sources

schedule_slice: User-owned schedules on the pilot tenant only, at most one daily digest schedule per pilot user; autonomous channel, event and business schedules stay read-only and draft-only (T0/T1) in the pilot and never post
workflow_slice: Read-only status reporting over workflows the asker may already read; no invocation, advancement, approval, or decision-target role for the agent anywhere in the pilot

displaced_work.workstream: First-pilot support coverage for agent answers
displaced_work.disposition: funded from the pilot tenant's existing support rotation; no Phase 1 engineering capacity is charged to this pilot proposal
deferred: SPONSORED runs stay T0/T1 in the pilot and post nothing until G-AGENT-OBO is green; candidate exchange only, with effort not estimated or accepted

spend_ceiling: Tenant-set cost envelope: at most 200 runs and $40 per pilot user per day, $2,000 total pilot spend; enforced by the budget ledger before a call is made; owner notified at 80 percent; new agent work pauses when reached
stop_criteria: Immediately disable agent work on any confirmed approval bypass, authority expansion beyond the asker's own, or cross-tenant disclosure, and preserve incident evidence.

Pause new agent work if the spend ceiling is reached, if a workflow or chat SLO under the gate breaches for 15 consecutive minutes, or if eval quality misses its target for two consecutive daily reviews; restore only after owner review and a clean observation window.
Roll back pilot activation if provider, gateway or budget-ledger failure leaves answers ungoverned, or if the support rotation cannot cover the pilot queue.
A tenant sponsor may request exit; revoke agent access, preserve required records, and complete the documented tenant exit before closing the pilot.

owners.responsibility: own the agent pilot problem, scope, adoption measures and product stop decision
own pilot support hours, escalation route, incident ownership and the tenant exit runbook
own the gateway, compiler and budget-ledger path, capacity, SLO evidence, on-call and rollback

reviewers.responsibility: approve identity mode, authorization, delegation, data handling, retention and revocation evidence
approve employee-monitoring posture, works-council obligations and disciplinary-conversation handling
approve tenant participation, cost envelope, incident route and release/stop authority

adopted_approval_defaults.rule: run inside the user-confirmed plan without a prompt
per-task confirmation of every destination is required
the user approves the exact digest per action or per listed batch

adopted_gate.shadow_period: T3 steps render as drafts only

phase1_position: Autonomous execution stays deferred in Phase 1: every T3 or T4 effect would be the signed-in user's own approved submission, and the pilot admits no T3 or T4 job at all; the two G-AGENT-OBO pushes (unattended T0/T1 work for days, batched exact-digest approval) ship only behind the gate with tenant opt-in

workflow_slos.name: workflow wake-up under agent load
workflow_slos.target: Candidate: wake-up p95 remains <= 5 seconds for due P0/P1 timers during pilot agent load, and the workflow-only regression stays within the budget CHAT-001 proposes. The thresholds are proposals requiring workflow-owner and Operations approval.

chat_slos.name: interactive chat reads unaffected
chat_slos.target: Candidate: p95 <= 500 ms for in-boundary reads at pilot peak, as CHAT-001 proposes; agent answers never jump the read queue. Requires product and Operations approval.

chat_slos.name: authorization revocation for agent answers
chat_slos.target: Candidate hard ceiling: the agent stops answering a removed user within 60 seconds of committed membership or identity revocation, matching the CHAT-001 revocation posture. Requires Security and Privacy approval.

required_signer_roles: Messaging Platform engineering and operations owner

design_only_evidence.claim: AGENT-001 through AGENT-005 prove design-stage security components, not a served agent product.
The AGENT-005 compiler turns validated agent output into an attributed draft; deterministic gateways perform all subsequent governance and execution. Design-stage and unserved.
The AGENT2-001 run modes, tiers, approval defaults and G-AGENT-OBO gate are adopted as this record's release position. A decision record, not served enforcement.

served_capability: Nothing served yet: no agent answers, schedules or posts run for any tenant until this scope decision is approved, G-AGENT-OBO is green and the pilot cohort is activated; the pilot then serves only the admitted T0 to T2 jobs above

source_evidence.claim: AGENT-006 requires a versioned scope decision naming cohort, provider, jobs, slices, displaced work, spend ceiling, stop criteria and reviewers, adopting the AGENT2-001 position.
OpenAI, Anthropic and approved private model endpoints supply inference behind adapters; this record serves one and defers the rest for the pilot.
AGENT2-001 fixes the run modes, side-effect tiers, approval defaults and the G-AGENT-OBO gate this record adopts verbatim.
CHAT-001 holds chat scope as a separate Gate C commitment; this record claims no chat-release scope and mirrors its SLO posture.
The execution plan holds the release decision; this artifact is its evidence, not a second authority.
